# Aadesh Salecha

> Aadesh Salecha is a Founding Engineer at Hyfin (San Francisco), building AI for clean energy finance. He holds an MS in Computer Science from Stanford University (2026) and a BS in Computer Science, summa cum laude, from the University of Minnesota. Previously: AI/ML Engineer at Amazon (AWS SageMaker HyperPod) and Senior Software Engineer at DraftKings. Research: geospatial ML for climate, and human-like biases in large language models (PNAS Nexus, covered by WIRED).

Focus areas: applied AI for climate, energy finance and planetary intelligence; agentic LLM systems and RAG; LLM evaluation; geospatial ML and remote sensing; applied NLP for psychology and social science.

Contact: aadeshsalecha@gmail.com

## Selected publications

- [Large Language Models Show Human-like Social Desirability Biases in Survey Responses](https://doi.org/10.1093/pnasnexus/pgae533): PNAS Nexus, 2024; first author. LLMs skew Big Five personality answers toward socially desirable traits when they can tell they are being evaluated.
- [Monitoring the Opioid Epidemic via Social Media Discussions](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-025-01642-x): npj Digital Medicine, 2025
- [Fake News Spreader Detection using Trust-based Strategies in Social Networks with Bot Filtration](https://doi.org/10.1007/s13278-022-00890-z): Social Network Analysis and Mining, 2022
